stories.title: PLACEHOLDER – Ibrahim will replace: NISAR sees the 2025 Aomori earthquake
stories.summary: PLACEHOLDER – Ibrahim will replace. Synthetic images that only exercise the story pipeline; not SAR data.

explanation.driver: PLACEHOLDER: an M7.6 earthquake offshore Aomori on 2025-12-08 (USGS us6000rtdt).
explanation.polarizationNote: PLACEHOLDER: L-band HH is sensitive to surface changes such as liquefaction and landslides.
explanation.howToRead: Blue = backscatter decreased after the event, red = increased. These images are synthetic.
explanation.caveats: Synthetic placeholder images, not SAR data.

credits: PLACEHOLDER imagery generated by the dev team (not SAR data)

stories.title: PLACEHOLDER – Ibrahim will replace: two L-band radars, SAOCOM + NISAR
stories.summary: PLACEHOLDER – Ibrahim will replace. Cross-sensor swipe (SAOCOM before, NISAR after) with synthetic images.
stories.place: Salado basin, Buenos Aires province, Argentina
stories.product: SAOCOM-1 L1D + NISAR L2 GCOV (PLACEHOLDER imagery)

layers.label: Cross-sensor visual comparison (not a computed change)

explanation.driver: PLACEHOLDER: autumn rain flooding the very flat Salado basin.
explanation.polarizationNote: PLACEHOLDER: both are L-band (~24 cm); HH shows open water dark and flooded vegetation bright.
explanation.howToRead: Swipe between SAOCOM (before) and NISAR (after). No change map: log-ratio is never computed across sensors.
explanation.caveats: Synthetic placeholder images, not SAR data.
